copy.headline: SEC Championship Game scenarios: How Texas can join Georgia in Atlanta
copy.caption: No. 5 Texas enters the final week of the regular season with a chance to face No. 1 Georgia in the SEC Championship Game. Here's what needs to happen for the Longhorns to reach Atlanta.
